answer: One identity per routed subnet. Registration records the ASN and /24 a key arrives through, and keys from the same block share one weight ceiling: the first gets full credit, the tenth gets a tenth, and a block holding five established keys must clear twice the graded answers to add a sixth. Fifty clones behind one residential pool collapse into one voice. Fine proxies run $2 to $5 an IP and a /24 leases near $600, so a farm pays that before it stands level with one agent on its own line. A juniper poisons the ground under itself while a lantern draws a vine from any fence it reaches.
